title: Cardmember Renewal Credit — Northgate Credit Cards Linked to Northgate Memberships
content:
A Northgate Credit Cards account linked to a membership of Northgate Memberships earns a cardmember renewal credit, taken off the renewal fee of a lapsed membership when that membership is renewed.

**Benefit term.** A Northgate credit card account that is linked to the membership and open, in active or restricted status, earns a cardmember renewal credit of 18.00 dollars when it is a Northgate Rewards Visa Signature Plus or Northgate Rewards Visa Business Plus, 12.00 dollars when it is a Northgate Rewards Visa Signature or Northgate Rewards Visa Business, and 6.00 dollars when it is a Northgate Store Card or Northgate Business Store Card; a membership with no open linked card account earns no cardmember renewal credit, and a closed card account never counts.

The card product, its status and the membership it is linked to are read from the card account record.

## Credit by card product

| Card account linked to the membership, open (active or restricted) | Cardmember renewal credit |
|---|---|
| Northgate Rewards Visa Signature Plus | 18.00 |
| Northgate Rewards Visa Business Plus | 18.00 |
| Northgate Rewards Visa Signature | 12.00 |
| Northgate Rewards Visa Business | 12.00 |
| Northgate Store Card | 6.00 |
| Northgate Business Store Card | 6.00 |
| no open linked card account | none |

## Status of the card account

| Card account status | Counts as open |
|---|---|
| active | Yes |
| restricted | Yes |
| closed | No — never counts |
| applied or declined | No — not an open account |

## Hypothetical cases

- A restricted Northgate Rewards Visa Signature account linked to the membership: 12.00 dollars.
- A closed Northgate Rewards Visa Signature Plus account linked to the membership and no other: no credit.
- An active Northgate Store Card account held by the member but linked to a different membership: it is not linked to this membership, so it earns this membership no credit.
